title: Lexicon page images (open-greek-lexica 0.3.0)
description: pages.json: one row per printed page (and column, where the lexicon records columns), in printed order, with the scan and leaf to show, links, access and credit. Leaves come from the scans' pinned scandata and page-number files, never from archive.org page labels.

scan.description: id of a scan in the manifest

leaf.description: the scan's image number for the page

viewer_url.description: link to the leaf in the provider's viewer; null when there is no public viewer

image_url.description: the page image; null unless access is public

fallback.description: other scans that have the page and can be linked, public ones first

first_seq.description: seq of the first entry on the page or column

last_seq.description: seq of the last entry on the page or column

max_line.description: the last column line an entry has there, where the lexicon numbers lines

note.description: what a reader should know about this page's image

scan.description: id of a scan in the manifest

leaf.description: the scan's image number for the page

viewer_url.description: link to the leaf in the provider's viewer; null when there is no public viewer

image_url.description: the page image; null unless access is public
